datasets.name: NASA POWER — Precipitation (MERRA-2)
datasets.temporal_resolution: daily → annual or JJAS seasonal totals (mm)
datasets.access: public REST API — no credentials required
datasets.note: MERRA-2 grid is ~0.5°×0.625° — suitable for Vidarbha region only, not individual districts.

datasets.name: NASA POWER — Temperature 2 m (MERRA-2)
datasets.access: public REST API — no credentials required
datasets.note: Annual mean is mean of daily means; units are °C as returned by NASA POWER AG community.

datasets.name: NASA POWER — Relative Humidity 2 m (MERRA-2)
datasets.access: public REST API — no credentials required

datasets.name: GPM IMERG V07 Final Daily
datasets.units_note: Native unit is mm/hr (daily mean rate). Multiply by 24 to obtain mm/day total.
datasets.access: Earthdata Login via earthaccess — credentials in .env
datasets.disabled_reason: Requires Earthdata Login (EARTHDATA_USERNAME / EARTHDATA_PASSWORD in .env). Adapter not yet implemented. Best for district-scale (~0.1°) precipitation — higher priority than POWER for sub-regional analysis.

datasets.name: MERRA-2 Monthly Single-Level Diagnostics
datasets.units_note: Native unit is Kelvin. Subtract 273.15 for °C.
datasets.access: Earthdata Login via earthaccess — credentials in .env
datasets.disabled_reason: Requires Earthdata Login. Good for long-term temperature trend (record since 1980). Adapter not yet implemented.

datasets.name: GLDAS Noah L4 Monthly 0.25°
datasets.access: Earthdata Login via earthaccess — credentials in .env
datasets.disabled_reason: Requires Earthdata Login. Useful for soil moisture and evapotranspiration trend alongside precipitation. Adapter not yet implemented.

datasets.name: Aqua AIRS L3 Monthly Standard Physical Retrieval
datasets.access: Earthdata Login via earthaccess — credentials in .env
datasets.disabled_reason: Requires Earthdata Login. 1° grid is too coarse for district analysis. Record ends 2016. Useful only as region-scale temperature cross-check. Adapter not yet implemented.

datasets.name: JPL GRACE/GRACE-FO Mascon (CRI) RL06.3 V4
datasets.variable_long: Liquid Water Equivalent Thickness (Total Water Storage Anomaly)
datasets.units_note: cm of equivalent water thickness relative to 2004–2009 baseline mean.
datasets.access: Earthdata Login via earthaccess — credentials in .env
datasets.disabled_reason: Requires Earthdata Login. Measures total water storage change — groundwater + surface water + soil. Region scale (~0.5°) only. Gap 2017-06 to 2018-06 between GRACE and GRACE-FO missions. Adapter not yet implemented.

giovanni.name: NASA Giovanni
giovanni.note: Cross-check only — never used as pipeline source. Use to verify our computed values for one point/region.

gesdisc.name: NASA GES DISC
gesdisc.note: Primary archive for GPM, MERRA-2, GLDAS, AIRS datasets.

podaac.name: NASA PO.DAAC
podaac.note: Primary archive for GRACE/GRACE-FO mascon products.

power.name: NASA POWER
power.note: Public API — no Earthdata credentials needed. MERRA-2 derived. Region scale only for Vidarbha.

earthdata.name: NASA Earthdata
earthdata.note: Central login and search portal for all NASA datasets requiring credentials.
